headline: SSX mountain surfaces get real
lede: The smooth-gradient mountain is gone: snow now carries wind cords, crust cracks, lit lumps and sun-glitter, while steep ground and ridges break through as layered, fractured rock with snow settled on the ledges — all look-only, physics untouched.

notes.text: #669 shipped (PR #682): slope-based snow/rock blending, ridge crags, wind ripples, detail texture + sparkle overlay. Live at jalfern.com/retrogames/ssx.
The renderer reads vertex colours as LINEAR — authored palettes lift a stop. That's why cliffs washed to grey plastic until rock was authored dark; lesson written into the game README.
New ssxterraincheck gate (30 checks, in CI static) with a mutant proof: re-including built features in the slope read goes red on exactly the right checks.
QA polish pass #685 filed: per-facet sparkle, night rock separation, CPU-rider spray, distant cliff banding.
